# Real validation case — macular OD

Anonymized DICOM output generated by Transducin from a real Optopol Revo FC130
`.OPT` acquisition. Data belongs to the corresponding author, who provides
explicit consent for its use as a validation case.

Identity tags anonymized: PatientID=`""`, PatientName=`"ANONYMOUS"`,
PatientBirthDate=`""`, PatientSex=`""`. All measurements and UIDs intact.

## Obtaining the fixture files

The DICOM files are not tracked in git. Generate them locally from the source
`.OPT` file available on Zenodo (doi:[10.5281/zenodo.20031717](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20031717)):

```bash
# Download JAHJ19870831_macular_OD.opt from Zenodo, then:
python -m transducin.revo_opt_reader JAHJ19870831_macular_OD.opt -o tests/fixtures/real/dicom/
```

## Expected output files

| File | SOP Class | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `dicom/*_macular_OD_SR.dcm` | Comprehensive SR TID 1500 | CMT, ETDRS 9-sector, mRNFL, mGCIPL measurements |
| `dicom/*_macular_OD_SLO.dcm` | OphthalmicPhotography8Bit | SLO en-face — confirms OD laterality |
| `dicom/*_macular_OD_ENFACE.dcm` | OphthalmicPhotography8Bit | FNDSRECO en-face projection |

## Key measurements (SR)

- CMT: 283.9 µm (SNOMED-CT 422453003 — Foveal retinal thickness)
- ETDRS 9-sector grid: present
- Laterality: right eye (OD)
- Acquisition date: 2026-02-26
- Device: Optopol Revo FC130, SOCT v21.1.2
